## Work item

Link the owning Issue or task contract when one exists.

## Summary

What outcome does this PR implement?

## Changes

Describe the smallest meaningful set of changes introduced by this PR.

## Verification

Record only checks that actually ran, including relevant commands, environments, devices, or runtime evidence.

## Validation gaps

What remains unverified or requires human / device / environment validation?

## Risk and rollback

Call out authentication, permissions, persistence, migration, signing, deployment, external side effects, or rollback concerns when relevant.

## Environment / promotion

Target: `dev` / `test` / `prod` / repository-specific exception.

A merge is implementation evidence, not automatic Issue acceptance or production-release authority.
